verdictScope: Design review of the bounded next-state native capture plan only; not runtime, Q12, or BIZQ-01 acceptance.

findings.finding: The prior Details run is not a product PASS. Maestro targeted the correct AX element but tapped its center at (201,769), which lies inside the fixed Next button visible in the native screenshot; the next screenshot and snapshot show Q2/index 1 with only the original Q1 attempt.

findings.classification: Observed tool-coordinate/pixel collision; Details handler defect is not established.

findings.finding: The follow-up must verify actual unobscured geometry and readback. A centered scroll command and an AX matcher are insufficient if the target still intersects the fixed footer.
findings.condition: Require the full Details bounds inside the scroll viewport and outside Next before tapping; after the tap, confirm expanded content and unchanged index/attempt count. Stop if unobscured positioning cannot be achieved.

findings.finding: The risk-based representative captures do not establish the complete Q12 matrix or a same-Q1 light/dark comparison.
findings.classification: Same-item dual-theme is a useful preference, not an explicit Q12 requirement; the spec requires legibility of long options and Details across large-text light/dark cases, and does not mandate every item in every theme.
